city_hall.name: City Hall
city_hall.idea: Seat of government: +10% tax collection and lowers crime/unrest citywide, boosts nearby commercial land value.

university.name: University
university.idea: Raises education level of residents within 15 tiles and attracts high-tech industry; needs a minimum city population of 20k.

library.name: Public Library
library.idea: Small education boost (+literacy) and land-value bonus for residential within 8 tiles; cheap upkeep.

museum.name: Art Museum
museum.idea: Tourism magnet: boosts commercial demand and land value within 12 tiles; +culture.

school.name: Elementary School
school.idea: Raises education of children within 8 tiles (feeds the education quotient); residents nearby pay more rent.

cathedral.name: Cathedral
cathedral.idea: Large landmark: reduces crime and raises residential desirability within 12 tiles; draws tourists (+commercial demand).

observatory.name: Observatory
observatory.idea: Science landmark: +education and +tech-industry demand; must be placed away from heavy pollution and bright high-density zones.

tv_tower.name: TV Tower
tv_tower.idea: Broadcast mast: raises commercial demand and city happiness (news/entertainment); slight land-value penalty right next to it.

prison.name: Prison
prison.idea: Holds criminals: cuts citywide crime and boosts police effectiveness, but lowers land value and residential demand within 6 tiles.

university_5x4.idea: Raises education level of residents within 15 tiles and attracts high-tech industry; needs a minimum city population of 20k.
